name: chef-app
description: Platebook — Personal Chef Business Management Platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web "npm run server" "npm run client"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix tests/http install && npm --prefix tools/migrate-sqlite install
scripts.build: npm --prefix client run build && node server-rs/scripts/cargo.mjs build --release
scripts.lint: node scripts/license-headers.mjs && npm --prefix client run lint && node server-rs/scripts/cargo.mjs fmt --check && node server-rs/scripts/cargo.mjs clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.lint:fix: node scripts/license-headers.mjs --fix && npm --prefix client run lint:fix && node server-rs/scripts/cargo.mjs fmt
scripts.test: npm run test:client && npm run test:server && npm run test:http && npm run test:migrate
scripts.test:migrate: npm --prefix tools/migrate-sqlite test && npm --prefix tools/migrate-sqlite run test:e2e
